description: Acterys Table Edit is an advanced Power BI table edit visual that redefines how users manage and update data within their reports. This custom Power BI visual for data editing enables intuitive, real-time editing, validation, and organization of data—without ever leaving the Power BI environment. Ideal for both enterprise and business users, Acterys Table Edit supports bulk changes, record-level updates, and data validation in Power BI, helping teams boost productivity and maintain accuracy across large datasets. It’s fully compatible with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, Snowflake, and other Acterys-supported data sources, offering seamless Power BI write-back table functionality. Whether you need to edit rows, group records, search large tables, or display images and icons inline—this visual streamlines it all. Key Features: Bulk & Record-Level Editing: Apply mass updates or targeted changes using filters to streamline workflows and save time. Organized Grouping: Group rows and columns to enhance readability and manage structured views effortlessly. Advanced Search & Filtering: Easily navigate and edit data with smart search and filtering options. Free Text Editing: Use a pop-out editor for column-level or long-form text entry, ideal for qualitative inputs.
